messages:
maya: Observed odd bump in "sampling rate" metric on console during the header migration canary. Looks like some tenants doubled counts.

owen: can you share the raw headers?

maya: repro: ts-sdk-canary emits X-RDWD-SAMPLE=v1, proxy still injects X-SAMPLED=true if it decides to sample. server ends up with both and downstream metrics count twice. curl: 
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer tok\" -H \"X-RDWD-SAMPLE: 1\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat
```

jess: UX-wise customers see per-route and per-tenant spikes; billing dedupers run later so cost not impacted but console alarms are noisy.

rick: quick wins: 1) server-side canonicalizer to normalize sample headers before metrics emit, 2) introduce a lightweight client-proxy handshake header SAMPLE_POLICY that indicates preference (client-first / proxy-first), 3) SDK opt-in guard env var to flip behavior during rollout.

lin: tests: CI failing because metrics suite expects single sample label. We need to update tests to account for handshake behavior and canonicalization.

owen: proxy change is low-risk: honor SAMPLE_POLICY=client-first if present and do not add X-SAMPLED when upstream client requested sampling. will gate rollout to 5% tenants initially. PR: proxy#111.

jess: console: add a "show deduped metrics" toggle and a small banner explaining values may be inflated during header migration. I'll also add a note in the metrics docs.

maya: SDKs: rick, can we put a temporary shim in ts/py sdks to advertise SAMPLE_POLICY and avoid injecting client header when RDWD_SAMPLE_MODE=client-first?

rick: yes. I'll open tiny canary PRs behind env flags: ts-sdk#9001, py-sdk#9002. Default off. Shim will set: 
```
SAMPLE_POLICY: client-first
X-RDWD-SAMPLE: 1    # only if client decides to sample
```

lin: server PR to canonicalize: ingest#221 merged (normalizes aliases and dedupes). CI green on ingest unit tests after adding new expectations.

deploy-bot: deploy proxy-canary v2.1.0-rc -> success (1819991400) :white_check_mark:

owen: rolling proxy canary to 5% now. will monitor console heatmaps and sampling-rate alarms.

rick: pushed ts/py canaries with env-driven handshake. smoke tests show only once-per-request sample label in the ingestion logs.

jess: console toggle added to feature flags (metrics.dedupe_preview). ops doc + short customer note ready.

maya: recon at 10:30 in #eng-platform to confirm heatmaps normalized. owners: owen(proxy), rick(sdks), lin(ingest), jess(console).

owen: TL;DR: duplicate sampling from client+proxy => console double-count. Mitigation: canonicalize headers ingest-side, introduce SAMPLE_POLICY handshake, SDK opt-in shim, console toggle, staged rollback guard.

maya: closing when post-rollout graphs are stable and changelogs published. :thumbsup:
